mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy environment remains accommodative.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% for two consecutive months signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 60-day returns, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 95.0 for three consecutive months signals strengthening supply chain activity and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 95.0 during post-recession recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates robust consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 228.0 for two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 228.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 0.25% and CPIAUCSL above 228.0 signal monetary tightening amid inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL fails to predict negative 20-day returns, with Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market cooling and reduced consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% during late-cycle expansion.
